items.title: Forget big tech: the real AI money is in plumbing
items.summary: Host Kenny Polcari joins Yahoo Finance's Jared Blikre and Founder ETFs' Michael Monaghan to explore the data showing why founder-led companies significantly outperform the market. The panel also breaks down the flawless execution of the SpaceX IPO, the overlooked opportunities in AI infrastructure, and why the next major productivity boom will mirror the historical shift from steam to electricity.

items.title: Nvidia is becoming the ‘central bank of AI’ as demand explodes
items.summary: Morning Brief Host Jake Conley welcomes Zacks Investment Management chief market strategist Brian Mulberry and Yahoo Finance's Tech Editor Dan Howley to discuss Nvidia (NVDA) growing role at the center of the AI boom as demand for its chips and compute continues to surge. The panel also looks at Jensen Huang’s aggressive dealmaking, including 66 partnerships and deals that have helped raise as much as $500 billion in capital for AI infrastructure.

items.title: Put options explained: How trading puts pays off and when it doesn't

items.summary: Micron keeps getting dismissed as a cyclical chip stock doomed to repeat the same boom-and-bust pattern, but one structural shift buried in its latest earnings call suggests that logic no longer applies the way investors assume.
